\section[o músculo]{o músculo — a muscle}

\label{lesson:PT-C180-musculo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for to lower, then the Portuguese for to defend.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o músculo}
\textbf{o músculo} — \textquotedblleft{}a muscle\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{músculo} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{musculus}, \textquotedblleft{}little mouse\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB 2.1) — a learned borrowing from Latin. A flexing muscle looked like a little mouse.
\end{cousinweb}
